title: Night Screams
description: David is a high school football hero whose parents have announced that they're going away for the weekend, which to David means it's time for a party; however, two killers escape from a nearby jail and crash the party.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E01 — Billabong
In the Australian Outback, an American family's vacation takes a nightmarish turn when they meet a local man named Mick Taylor.

title: Wolf Creek
description:

Haunted by the massacre of her parents and brother, Eve sets out on a quest for revenge; in Kutyukutyu, Eve runs afoul of the local police and lands in a jail cell; Mick Taylor finds out that an American teenager is looking for him.

title: Mortuary
description: A girl (Mary McDonough) and her boyfriend (David Wallace) suspect her mother (Lynda Day George) and an undertaker are embalming people too soon.

title: Bloodsucking Bastards
description: An office worker (Fran Kranz) springs into action after learning that his colleague (Pedro Pascal) is a scheming vampire.

title: The Taking of Deborah Logan

description:
